articles.title: Florida Sues OpenAI, Sam Altman Over ChatGPT Safety Claims
articles.snippet: Florida's attorney general seeks damages, restrictions on ChatGPT, and personal liability for OpenAI CEO Sam Altman in what the state describes as the first state-led lawsuit against the AI company.

articles.title: What Is an AI Prompt Injection Attack? The Hidden Threat Hijacking Your Chatbots
articles.snippet: Hackers can hijack ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini with nothing but a sentence. OpenAI says the problem may never be fully solved. Here is what it is, how it works, and how to stay safe.

articles.title: Anthropic Nears $1 Trillion Valuation, Topping OpenAI After Fresh $65 Billion Raise
articles.snippet: Claude maker Anthropic said annualized revenue surpassed $47 billion as it expands cloud and compute partnerships.
